lines.text: James tells the brothers to be patient like a farmer who waits for the fall and spring rains.
James says the Judge stands at the door, prophets model patience, and the Lord is full of mercy.
James says not to swear, to sing praises when cheerful, and to call the deacons of the church when sick.
The prayer offered in faith restores the sick, and Elijah's prayer stopped the rain for three and a half months.
After Elijah prayed again, the heavens gave rain, and turning a sinner from error saves his soul from death.
